nodes.name: get-response-metadata.ts
nodes.summary: Extracts standardized response metadata (id, modelId, timestamp) from an OpenAI-compatible chat completion response payload for the vendored Copilot SDK.

nodes.name: getResponseMetadata
nodes.summary: Normalizes the id/model/created fields of a chat completion into the AI SDK provider metadata shape, converting the epoch seconds timestamp to a Date.

nodes.name: map-openai-compatible-finish-reason.ts
nodes.summary: Maps OpenAI chat-completions finish_reason strings to the unified AI SDK finish reason vocabulary for the Copilot SDK's chat model.

nodes.name: mapOpenAICompatibleFinishReason
nodes.summary: Translates chat-completions stop reasons (stop, length, content_filter, tool_calls) into the LanguageModelV3 unified finish-reason union, defaulting to "other".

nodes.name: openai-compatible-api-types.ts
nodes.summary: Type-only definitions of the OpenAI-compatible chat completions wire format: message roles, content parts (text/image/file), assistant tool_calls, and streaming chunk shapes with JSON-record extensibility.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an extensible JsonRecord base type so provider-specific metadata can ride along on every message and content part without breaking the core wire types.

nodes.name: openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts
nodes.summary: Core chat-completions LanguageModelV3 implementation for the vendored Copilot SDK: builds request args (tools, provider options, messages), posts JSON to the API, and parses both non-streaming responses and SSE chunk streams including incremental tool-call argument assembly.
nodes.languageNotes: The doStream TransformStream accumulates tool_call fragments in a pendingToolCalls map keyed by index (some providers omit the index) and merges argument deltas before emitting a complete tool-call part; the zod chunk schema also carries Copilot-specific reasoning_text/reasoning_opaque fields.

nodes.name: OpenAICompatibleChatLanguageModel
nodes.summary: Implements the AI SDK LanguageModelV3 interface over the OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint; getArgs assembles body/options/warnings, doGenerate returns one content array, and doStream pipes SSE through a stateful transform that emits text/tool-call/reasoning deltas and finish metadata.

nodes.name: createOpenAICompatibleChatChunkSchema
nodes.summary: Builds the zod schema used to validate each SSE chunk, parameterized by the provider's error schema and including Copilot-specific reasoning fields and delta-shaped tool_calls.

nodes.name: openai-compatible-chat-options.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the zod-validated openaiCompatibleProviderOptions schema (user, reasoningEffort, textVerbosity, Copilot thinking_budget) accepted by the chat model's provider options.

nodes.name: openai-compatible-metadata-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the MetadataExtractor interface that lets providers surface provider-specific metadata from complete responses or accumulate it across streaming chunks.

nodes.name: openai-compatible-prepare-tools.ts
nodes.summary: Converts AI SDK tool definitions and toolChoice into the chat-completions tools payload, filtering unsupported tool types and collecting unsupported-tool warnings.

nodes.name: prepareTools
nodes.summary: Maps LanguageModelV3 tool definitions to OpenAI function-tool JSON (name, description, strict-JSON-schema parameters) and translates toolChoice modes, warning on tool types the endpoint cannot represent.

nodes.name: copilot-provider.ts
nodes.summary: Provider factory for the vendored Copilot SDK: createOpenaiCompatible wires baseURL, bearer-auth headers, and a user-agent suffix into chat and responses language model constructors, returning a callable provider with .chat/.responses/.languageModel methods.

nodes.name: createOpenaiCompatible
nodes.summary: Builds an OpenAI-compatible provider instance that normalizes the base URL, merges auth headers, and instantiates OpenAICompatibleChatLanguageModel or OpenAIResponsesLanguageModel per requested model type.

nodes.name: openai-compatible-error.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the zod schema for OpenAI-style error bodies plus the ProviderErrorStructure contract (errorSchema, errorToMessage, optional isRetryable) and its default implementation for the chat model.

nodes.name: convert-to-openai-responses-input.ts
nodes.summary: Converts AI SDK ModelMessages into OpenAI Responses API input items, handling file-ID detection versus base64 media, tool calls and results, reasoning items with summaries, local-shell calls/outputs, and approval deduplication.
nodes.languageNotes: A ~310-line single exported converter that walks every message/part kind; fileIdPrefixes (e.g. 'file-' for OpenAI, 'assistant-' for Azure) decide whether binary data is sent as a file reference or an inline base64 data URL.

nodes.name: convertToOpenAIResponsesInput
nodes.summary: Single-pass converter from ModelMessage arrays to Responses API input: emits system/user/assistant items, merges tool outputs and reasoning summaries, validates local-shell payloads against their zod schemas, and collects warnings for unsupported parts.

nodes.name: map-openai-responses-finish-reason.ts
nodes.summary: Maps OpenAI Responses API finish reasons (e.g. stop, length, content_filter) to unified AI SDK finish reasons, upgrading to tool-calls when function output is present.

nodes.name: mapOpenAIResponseFinishReason
nodes.summary: Translates a Responses API status/finish reason into the unified finish reason, returning "tool-calls" when the response contains function call output regardless of the raw reason string.

nodes.name: openai-config.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the OpenAIConfig type shared by the Responses language model: provider name, URL builder, header factory, fetch override, optional ID generator, and fileIdPrefixes for file-ID versus base64 detection.

nodes.name: openai-error.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the zod error-body schema for the Responses API and builds the openaiFailedResponseHandler used to surface API errors as retryable provider failures.

nodes.name: openai-responses-api-types.ts
nodes.summary: Type-only wire-format definitions for the OpenAI Responses API: input items (message, function_call, reasoning, local_shell), output items (text, reasoning, tool calls, code interpreter, image generation, web search), streaming events, and include options.

nodes.name: openai-responses-language-model.ts
nodes.summary: LanguageModelV3 implementation over the OpenAI Responses API: assembles requests via convertToOpenAIResponsesInput and prepareResponsesTools, applies per-model config from getResponsesModelConfig, and reduces response output items and SSE events (text deltas, reasoning summaries, function-call arguments, code-interpreter output, image partials, annotations) into AI SDK content parts.
nodes.languageNotes: Streaming is decoded by ~15 small isX type-guard predicates (isTextDeltaChunk, isResponseOutputItemDoneChunk, ...) that discriminate the typed SSE event union before the TransformStream reducer; vendor-specific reasoning summary parts are reassembled from added/delta events.

nodes.name: OpenAIResponsesLanguageModel
nodes.summary: The Responses API language model class: getArgs builds the request body (model config, input conversion, tool preparation, include flags), doGenerate validates and reduces a complete response, and doStream pipes SSE events through a stateful transform into AI SDK stream parts.

nodes.name: getResponsesModelConfig
nodes.summary: Infers model capabilities (reasoning display, verbosity control, storage) from model-ID prefixes so the request omits include flags and options the specific model does not support.

nodes.name: openai-responses-prepare-tools.ts
nodes.summary: Converts AI SDK tool definitions into Responses API tool objects, recognizing built-in OpenAI hosted tools (file search, web search, web search preview, code interpreter, image generation) by ID and validating their args against the per-tool zod schemas.

nodes.name: prepareResponsesTools
nodes.summary: Maps each tool to the Responses tool format, parsing hosted-tool configuration from tool metadata schemas and emitting warnings for unsupported tool types or invalid hosted-tool arguments.

nodes.name: openai-responses-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Single-line type alias declaring OpenAIResponsesModelId as a plain string model identifier for the Responses language model.

nodes.name: code-interpreter.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted code-interpreter tool for the Responses API: zod schemas for input (code, containerId), output (logs/images), and args (container or file IDs), plus the tool factory wrapper.

nodes.name: codeInterpreter
nodes.summary: Thin exported wrapper that instantiates the code-interpreter provider tool with its input/output schemas.

nodes.name: file-search.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted file-search tool: zod schemas for vector-store args (with recursive comparison/compound filters) and scored search results, plus the tool factory.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses z.lazy for a self-referential compound filter schema (and/or trees of comparison filters), one of the few recursive zod schemas in the subtree.

nodes.name: image-generation.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted image-generation tool: a strict zod args schema (background, fidelity, mask, format, quality, size, partial images), output schema, and the tool factory wrapper.

nodes.name: imageGeneration
nodes.summary: Thin exported wrapper that instantiates the image-generation provider tool with its input/output schemas.

nodes.name: local-shell.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI local-shell tool (id openai.local_shell): zod schemas for exec actions (command array, timeout, env, working directory) and plain-text output, plus the tool factory.

nodes.name: web-search-preview.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted web-search-preview tool: args schema for search context size and approximate user location, and the prompt-driven tool factory (no direct input parameters).

nodes.name: web-search.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted web-search tool: args schema for domain filters, search context size, and user location, plus the tool factory and its wrapper.

nodes.name: webSearch
nodes.summary: Thin exported wrapper that instantiates the web-search provider tool with its args schema.

nodes.name: transform.ts
nodes.summary: The ProviderTransform orchestrator that adapts opencode's internal model contract to each AI SDK provider: normalizeMessages fans out to per-provider transform modules, then message/options/providerOptions/variants compute sanitized messages, sampling parameters, reasoning-effort variants, and provider-option keys per model.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the documented orchestrator pattern: a 41-line normalizeMessages dispatcher (transform.ts:97-137) over 7 sibling modules under provider/transform/ (sanitize, anthropic, bedrock, claude-ids, mistral, deepseek, interleaved), with variants() being a ~340-line per-model capability table.

nodes.name: systemPromptDelivery
nodes.summary: Decides whether the system prompt is delivered as messages or via the instructions field; OpenAI OAuth lacks system-role support so it returns instructions for that auth type.

nodes.name: shouldUseInstructions
nodes.summary: Deprecated boolean wrapper over systemPromptDelivery kept for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: supportsMediaInToolResult
nodes.summary: Reports whether a provider accepts media attachments inside tool results or requires extracting them into a separate user message; per-SDK rules with a Gemini-3-only allowance for Google.

nodes.name: sdkKey
nodes.summary: Maps an AI SDK npm package name to the providerOptions key the SDK expects (e.g. @ai-sdk/github-copilot to "copilot", ai-gateway-provider to camelCase "openaiCompatible" to avoid a deprecation warning).

nodes.name: normalizeMessages
nodes.summary: Dispatches messages through the per-provider normalization pipeline: sanitize, Anthropic/Bedrock empty-content removal, Claude tool-call ID scrubbing, Anthropic tool_use reordering, Mistral normalization, DeepSeek reasoning injection, and interleaved reasoning extraction.

nodes.name: applyCaching
nodes.summary: Injects prompt-caching provider options for Anthropic-style providers by finding stable tool/system breakpoints in the last non-system message and merging cache-control metadata deep into the message tree.

nodes.name: unsupportedParts
nodes.summary: Flags message parts whose media modality (image/audio/video/pdf) the target model does not accept, so callers can strip or convert them before the API call.

nodes.name: message
nodes.summary: Entry point producing the final ModelMessage array: detects multi-part-capable models, applies normalization and caching, then remaps file/text parts when a model only supports single-part content.

nodes.name: temperature
nodes.summary: Suppresses temperature for reasoning/thinking model families (o-series, thinking variants, K2, etc.) that reject explicit temperature settings.

nodes.name: topP
nodes.summary: Suppresses top_p for model families (minimax-m2, gemini, kimi-k2.5) that reject the parameter.

nodes.name: topK
nodes.summary: Suppresses top_k for minimax m2-family models and only allows it for Anthropic and Gemini providers.

nodes.name: variants
nodes.summary: Builds the per-model capability/variant table: reasoning-effort ladders for OpenAI/GPT-5, Anthropic adaptive thinking, and Gemini thinking levels, expanded into named model variants with their supported effort values.

nodes.name: options
nodes.summary: Computes the reasoning/sampling option set for a request: maps the requested effort onto the model's variant ladder (GPT-5 versioned efforts, Claude adaptive/fixed thinking, Gemini thinking budgets) and returns provider-shaped settings.

nodes.name: smallOptions
nodes.summary: Returns reduced-cost option presets for small/fast model tiers, mapping the effort ladder onto cheaper reasoning budgets.

nodes.name: providerOptions
nodes.summary: Assembles the providerOptions payload keyed by the SDK package name (via sdkKey), merging reasoning, caching, and provider-specific settings into the shape each AI SDK package expects.

nodes.name: maxOutputTokens
nodes.summary: Returns the OUTPUT_TOKEN_MAX cap (experimental flag override or 32,000) applied to generation requests.

nodes.name: schema
nodes.summary: Converts and sanitizes a JSON schema for structured-output usage, normalizing it into the strict shape providers require and gating on the model's structured-output support.

nodes.name: anthropic.ts
nodes.summary: Anthropic-specific message transforms for ProviderTransform: removeEmptyContent delegates to the shared helper, and reorderToolUseBlocks fixes assistant turns where tool_use blocks precede text (which Anthropic rejects) by splitting them into text-then-tool_use messages.
nodes.languageNotes: reorderToolUseBlocks is a documented workaround for upstream stream ordering: [tool_use, text] is reshaped into two messages because consecutive assistant messages are later merged by the provider SDK, which would otherwise resurrect the invalid payload order.

nodes.name: removeEmptyContent
nodes.summary: Anthropic-flavored wrapper over the shared remove-empty-content helper, dropping messages whose content array became empty after sanitization.

nodes.name: reorderToolUseBlocks
nodes.summary: Splits assistant messages mixing tool calls with trailing non-tool content into a text message followed by a tool-call-only message, satisfying Anthropic's requirement that tool_use blocks be immediately followed by tool_result blocks.
